Players Committee card image of [[Help Me Obi-Wan Kenobi (V)]] (original printing), game text: “During battle, target an opponent's character of ability of < 2 present with your Jedi;  target is excluded from battle. OR Cancel a 'react'. OR If Obi-Wan is at a battleground site, and your Rebel of Republic character (or Leia) is in battle at another location, add one battle destiny.”

Source: <code>Images-HT/starwars/Virtual7-Light/large/helpmeobiwankenobi.gif</code> in the Players Committee's Holotable image repository, version of commit [https://github.com/swccgpc/holotable/commit/022435b7929e4de26dafbcb1de2ec1d6d04d2153 022435b] (8 July 2018). The PC serves its card images from this repository at res.starwarsccg.org; this is an earlier version of that file.

Edits: none. The repository's bytes are uploaded unchanged.
